courses.title: Time Management & Deep Work for Developers
courses.summary: Protect focused time for real work in a job full of interruptions and context-switching.
courses.description: A short, practical course on managing time and attention in a technical role: structuring a day around deep work, managing interruptions, and avoiding the context-switching that quietly kills productivity.
outcomes: Structure a workday around protected deep-work blocks
Reduce costly context-switching between tasks
Manage interruptions without damaging relationships
Build a sustainable, repeatable weekly routine
